kind.detail: STORY-3202 review at 4c941fb51e4a (base: integration, 5 commits behind; the finding is in run_review_agent, which the newer integration commits do not touch). Most of AC-A, AC-B and AC-C passes. The agy vendor goes through the hardened RunnerCall spawn: empty cwd, env allowlist with only GEMINI_API_KEY added, --print= reading stdin, --sandbox, --mode=plan, deny-all --settings, and --print-timeout set inside the deadline. A failed run with agy's sign-in stderr becomes a typed AuthRequired. The `agy models` lane-host probe returns typed Ready, KeyringOnly, Rejected, Timeout or Failed, is required only when agy is an enabled lane vendor, and is covered by fake-agy tests. The automatic challenger pick filters out agy (confinement_verified=false), and --post-comment refuses agy as finder or challenger before any runner starts. One blocking hole: confinement_verified says an unverified vendor runs only when named explicitly, but the finder is still chosen from `[agents] vendor`, which is read from the reviewed checkout. A PR under review can therefore switch the finder to agy. CI was pending at review time and is not the reason for this verdict.
